dog.description_text:
Dave is a professional napper, snack enthusiast, backyard explorer, and expert at making people smile. He believes every walk is an adventure, every squeaky toy is a personal challenge, and every meal should come with a second serving. 🎾🥓

When he’s not chasing squirrels or proudly carrying around his favorite toy, you can usually find Dave soaking up the sun, demanding belly rubs, or taking a well-earned nap after a long day of doing absolutely everything.

Dave may have four paws, but he has a personality bigger than life. He’s loyal, goofy, lovable, and always ready to turn an ordinary day into a good one. ❤️🐶

Follow along for tail wags, muddy paws, questionable decisions, and plenty of adorable moments with Dave!

This cutie resides at our Westhampton location If you are interested in meeting them, you must click "Apply for Adoption" to submit an online application. If you're viewing this animal on Petfinder, please visit the animal's page on Bideawee.org and click on the "Apply for Adoption" button to submit an adoption application. Prior to adoption, all of our animals are spayed/neutered, microchipped and given their age-appropriate vaccines
